A '''bronze bar''' is a bar of refined [[bronze]]. It can be created through the [[Smithing]] skill at level 1 by using a [[copper ore]] and a [[tin ore]] on a [[furnace]], granting 6.2 Smithing [[experience]]. A bronze bar can be smithed on an [[anvil]] through the Smithing skill to create [[bronze weapons]] and [[bronze armour|armour]]. A list of bronze items that can be smithed from bronze bars and the Smithing levels required can be found [[Smithing#Bronze|here]]. When smithed, each bar gives 12.5 experience, with a maximum of 62.5 experience given for the [[bronze platebody]].

[[Members]] can purchase bronze bars from the [[Shantay Pass Shop]] in the [[Shantay Pass]] south of [[Al Kharid]] for 8 coins each, or from [[Jiminua's Jungle Store]] north of [[Tai Bwo Wannai]] village for 12 coins each.

4-6 bronze bars are required for [[quests]]. [[Observatory Quest]] requires 1, [[The Tourist Trap]] requires 1-3 (dependent on the luck), [[Prince Ali Rescue]] requires 1 and [[One Small Favour]] requires 1. Furthermore, [[Creature of Fenkenstrain]] and [[Recipe for Disaster/Freeing Pirate Pete]] require 3 [[bronze wire]]s each, for a total of 10-12 bronze bars.
